note: Hand-written duplicate pairs for E2 (dataset v1): each pair describes the same problem in different words. Written and labelled by one person on 2026-09-21 (threat to validity, evaluation-methodology.md §5). Merged into duplicates.json by experiment:generate-duplicates.

a.title: Cannot login after password reset
a.description: Login page shows error ERR-401 after I reset my password.

b.title: Login fails after resetting password
b.description: Error ERR-401 on login page.

a.title: Two-factor code never arrives
a.description: I enabled two-factor authentication but the SMS code never reaches my phone.

b.title: Not receiving 2FA SMS
b.description: The verification code for two-factor login is not sent to my mobile.

a.title: Invitation link expired for new hire
a.description: Our new accountant clicked the invitation link and it says the link has expired.

b.title: New user invite says expired
b.description: The invite email we sent to our new accountant shows an expired link message.

a.title: Account locked after failed attempts
a.description: My account got locked after three wrong passwords and I cannot unlock it.

b.title: Locked out of my account
b.description: After typing the wrong password a few times the account is locked and there is no unlock option.

a.title: Single sign-on redirects in a loop
a.description: When I sign in with Microsoft SSO the page keeps redirecting back to the start.

b.title: SSO login loop
b.description: Signing in through Microsoft single sign-on loops between the login page and the portal.

a.title: Cannot change my email address
a.description: The profile page gives an error when I try to update my email address.

b.title: Email change fails on profile
b.description: Updating the email on my profile shows an error and the old address stays.

a.title: Logged out every few minutes
a.description: The portal logs me out every five minutes even while I am working.

b.title: Session expires too quickly
b.description: My session keeps ending after a few minutes and I have to log in again.

a.title: Charged twice for September subscription
a.description: Our card was charged twice for the September subscription renewal.

b.title: Duplicate charge on card
b.description: We see two identical charges for the subscription this month on our company card.

a.title: Invoice amount does not match contract
a.description: The invoice for August shows 1200 but our contract says 950 per month.

b.title: Wrong amount on August invoice
b.description: August invoice total is higher than the monthly price agreed in our contract.

a.title: Refund not received
a.description: We cancelled the extra licences two weeks ago but the refund has not arrived.

b.title: Still waiting for refund
b.description: The refund for the cancelled licences is not in our bank account yet.

a.title: Cannot download invoice PDF
a.description: Clicking download on the invoice page gives a blank PDF.

b.title: Invoice PDF is blank
b.description: The invoice download shows an empty page instead of the PDF.

a.title: VAT number missing on invoices
a.description: Our VAT registration number is not printed on the invoices.

b.title: Invoices without tax number
b.description: The company tax number does not appear on our invoices and finance needs it.

a.title: Payment declined with valid card
a.description: The payment is declined although the card works everywhere else.

b.title: Card payment keeps getting declined
b.description: Our valid credit card is rejected every time we try to pay the bill.

a.title: Update billing address
a.description: We moved offices and the billing address on invoices is still the old one.

b.title: Old address printed on invoices
b.description: Invoices still show our previous office address after the move.

a.title: Dashboard very slow to load
a.description: The dashboard takes more than a minute to load since Monday.

b.title: Dashboard loading takes forever
b.description: Since Monday the main dashboard is extremely slow, around one minute to open.

a.title: CSV export times out
a.description: Exporting the ticket list to CSV times out for large date ranges.

b.title: Export fails for big reports
b.description: The CSV export stops with a timeout when I choose a long period.

a.title: File upload fails over 10 MB
a.description: Uploading attachments larger than 10 MB fails with an error.

b.title: Cannot attach large files
b.description: Attachments bigger than ten megabytes are rejected with an upload error.

a.title: Search returns no results
a.description: Searching for customer names returns nothing even though the records exist.

b.title: Search not finding customers
b.description: Customer names that exist in the system do not show up in search.

a.title: Mobile app crashes on start
a.description: The Android app closes immediately after opening since the latest update.

b.title: App crashing on Android
b.description: After updating, the Android application crashes as soon as it starts.

a.title: API returns 500 error
a.description: Our integration gets HTTP 500 from the tickets API since this morning.

b.title: Server error from tickets API
b.description: Calls to the tickets API fail with internal server error 500 starting today.

a.title: Calendar sync stopped
a.description: Events from the helpdesk no longer appear in our Google calendar.

b.title: Google calendar not syncing
b.description: The helpdesk calendar stopped syncing events to Google.

a.title: VPN disconnects every few minutes
a.description: The VPN connection drops every five minutes when working from home.

b.description: Working remotely, my VPN session disconnects repeatedly after a few minutes.

a.title: Office wifi very slow
a.description: The wifi on the second floor is extremely slow since yesterday.

b.title: Slow wireless on second floor
b.description: Wireless internet on floor two has been crawling since yesterday.

a.title: Cannot reach shared network drive
a.description: The shared drive S: is not reachable from any office computer.

b.title: Network drive unavailable
b.description: Nobody in the office can open the S: shared drive.

a.title: Remote desktop connection fails
a.description: Remote desktop to the accounting server fails with a connection error.

b.title: Cannot connect to accounting server via RDP
b.description: RDP to the accounting server shows connection failed.

a.title: Website blocked by firewall
a.description: The firewall blocks our supplier portal so we cannot place orders.

b.title: Supplier portal blocked
b.description: We cannot open the supplier ordering portal because the firewall blocks it.

a.title: Video calls freezing
a.description: Video calls freeze and drop audio during meetings in the main office.

a.description: My laptop does not power on even when it is plugged in.

a.title: External monitor not detected
a.description: The second monitor is not detected when connected to the docking station.

b.title: Docking station monitor no signal
b.description: My external screen shows no signal through the dock.

a.title: Laptop battery drains fast
a.description: The laptop battery goes from full to empty in about an hour.

b.title: Battery lasts only one hour
b.description: My notebook battery runs out within an hour of use.

a.title: Headset microphone not working
a.description: Colleagues cannot hear me because the headset microphone is not working.

b.title: Mic on headset silent
b.description: My headset mic produces no sound in calls.

a.title: Projector in meeting room flickers
a.description: The projector in meeting room four flickers during presentations.

b.title: Flickering projector room 4
b.description: Presentations in room four are hard to watch because the projector keeps flickering.

a.title: Keyboard keys stuck
a.description: Several keys on my keyboard are stuck after a coffee spill.

b.description: I spilled coffee and now some keys do not work.

a.title: Request for admin training

b.title: Training for new admins
b.description: We need a training session for the two administrators who joined this month.

a.title: Documentation for reports is outdated
a.description: The help article about reports still shows the old menu.

b.description: The documentation page on reports describes a menu that no longer exists.

a.title: Need more licences
a.description: We need five additional user licences for the new branch office.

b.title: Additional licences for branch
b.description: Please add five more user licences for our new branch.

b.description: What is the retention period for tickets and files after deletion?
